## CONTEXT

### Hypersnap Read Node (doc 643)

ZAO is running a Hypersnap read node. The Nov 12 fork happened; the node upgraded to 0.17.5. The bootstrap-peer fix for read nodes is documented. Decision remains: stay as a read node, not a validator (no token rewards, cost-benefit doesn't close for a validator seat). This gives ZAO data sovereignty and custom indexing on Farcaster's social graph without the cost of a full validator.

## CATEGORIZED

### Infrastructure
- ZAO is running a Hypersnap read node. Upgraded to 0.17.5 for the Nov 12 fork. Bootstrap-peer fix documented. Doc 643 now reflects this as current state.

### ZOE Intelligence (shipped Mon-Thu this week)
- Failure memory: ZOE workers start each task knowing their recent failures. Frames them as records, not raw errors.
- Research critic: ZOE's research subagent now fetches every cited URL. A dead link fails the doc. This closes the fabricated-citation loop.
- Haiku tier classifier: the ZOE concierge can now route simple queries to Haiku (behind ZOE_MODEL_CLASSIFIER). Cost at scale.
- Concierge golden set: ZOE now has a real test suite with a scorer. No more flying blind on concierge quality.
- Hermes write-set enforcement: a Hermes build can only touch the files it declared. The forbidden-path check now catches new files too.
